title: Security Hardening
description: SSRF guards, hash verification, no eval, no shell injection.

rules.message: External HTTP call without SSRF guard — attacker can target internal services.
rules.remediation: Pass URL through assertSafeUrl() first (see MarketplaceService.ts). Only whitelisted hosts may skip.

rules.message: eval() is forbidden — code injection vector.
rules.remediation: Use JSON.parse, Function constructor with allowlist, or refactor to a switch/map.

rules.message: Shell command built with template interpolation — command injection risk.
rules.remediation: Use execFile / spawn with arg array, never string-interpolate untrusted input into a shell string.

rules.message: Route declared without explicit auth middleware — verify it's intentionally public.
rules.remediation: Add protectCentralAPI middleware unless this is an /health or /webhook callback endpoint.
